shortDescription: Perform a upload with lcm upload api

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: checksum
options.description: Specifies the checksum of uploading file encoded in SHA512

options.name: component_bundle
options.description: The path of the file to be uploaded on the local machine

options.name: customized_component
options.description: Specifies if the uploading file is a customized component. (true/false)

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for uploading customized component, the default value is 3600 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
